What is the latest publication by 'Becker, Jens'?
sparql: SELECT ?title WHERE { ?publication <https://schema.org/author> <https://data.gesis.org/gesiskg/resource/gesis-bib-97416_Becker_Jens> . ?publication <https://schema.org/name> ?title . ?publication <https://schema.org/datePublished> ?date . } ORDER BY DESC(?date) LIMIT 1

question: Which publication covers the most diverse topics?
sparql: SELECT ?title WHERE { { SELECT ?publication WHERE { ?publication <https://schema.org/about> ?topic . } GROUP BY ?publication ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(DISTINCT ?topic)) LIMIT 1 } ?publication <https://schema.org/name> ?title . }
